attr.title: Super Mario Sunshine
attr.desc: A native port of Super Mario Sunshine: the game's code is translated from your own disc on the device and runs on gc-recomp and Starlet.
attr.inst: Copy your own disc image of Super Mario Sunshine (USA, GMSE01) as .iso, .gcm or .rvz to the sunshine/gamefiles folder, next to the Super Mario Sunshine launcher in your ports folder. The first launch translates the game's code from the disc, which takes a few seconds.
